tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background behind the stage, dock and panel.

tokens.name: stage
tokens.usage: Stage surface that holds the word and the faint grid.

tokens.name: panel
tokens.usage: Dock and lesson panel surface.

tokens.name: tile
tokens.usage: Visual tile in the lesson panel, slider track, range track.

tokens.name: chip
tokens.usage: Header buttons and idle icon toggles.

tokens.name: button-2
tokens.usage: Secondary button fill, such as Previous.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and focus rings. 4.5:1 or more on stage, panel and ground.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Body text in the lesson panel.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Captions, step counts and slider labels. 4.5:1 or more on panel and stage.

tokens.name: mode-kerning
tokens.usage: Accent of Kerning mode. Fill for primary buttons and the gap tint source.

tokens.name: mode-tracking
tokens.usage: Accent of Tracking mode.

tokens.name: mode-leading
tokens.usage: Accent of Leading mode.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Current mode accent. Components use this token. A mode sets it to its own mode token.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill. 4.5:1 or more on every mode accent.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Gap block fill on the stage. Shows space as a shape.

tokens.name: accent-tint-strong
tokens.usage: Gap block fill inside lesson visuals.

tokens.name: bar
tokens.usage: Inactive lesson progress bar. Decorative only; always pair with the step text.

tokens.name: grid
tokens.usage: Faint stage grid line. One cell is one square of gap.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Lesson title. Write a full claim, not a topic label.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Lesson body. Left aligned. 17px or more.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Tips, readouts and slider labels. Never below 16px.

styles.name: stage-word
styles.usage: The word under test. Set font-kerning none so the learner controls the space.

styles.name: stage-word-compact
styles.usage: The word when the lesson panel is open on a landscape iPad.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Progress bar gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a title and its body.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between buttons.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel gap, dock vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between stage, dock and panel.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Dock horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page top padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page side padding.

tokens.name: tap-target
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area for any control on iPad.

tokens.name: grid-cell
tokens.usage: One grid square on the stage. Scales by 0.8 with the panel open.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Progress bars and small gap blocks.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Icon toggle chip.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Lesson visual tile.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Dock.

tokens.name: radius-2xl
tokens.usage: Stage and lesson panel.
